## What changed

Describe the focused change and the user problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build:pages`
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests where practical

## Community checklist

- [ ] The change preserves browser-only processing and does not add tracking
- [ ] Documentation and translations are updated when behavior changes
- [ ] The pull request links to a relevant issue
